title: AGIBOT introduces Worken to measure robot productivity at AGIBOT Innovation Day 2026
displayTitle: 智元提出 Worken 指标，并发布新一轮具身产品
summary: The Robot Report 10 月 29 日报道，智元在上海创新日提出 Worken（有效智能工时），试图用活跃机器人数量、自治工作时长和产出效率衡量真实生产力。同场展示 AHA3、GO-3 Preview、WITA-Omni 1.0、G2 Max 与 Link-U OS 1.0。Worken 目前是公司提出的框架，非行业标准。
investorNote: 机器人从出货量转向可核算工时是合理方向，但指标能否比较不同场景，还要看第三方对自治时长和合格产出的审计。
narrative: 智元在创新日提出 Worken 指标，计算思路是活跃机器人数量乘以自主工作时长和产出效率，并同期展示模型、硬件与系统更新。这套指标把注意力从交付台数转向实际作业，但目前仍是公司提出的框架；能否成为跨厂商口径，需要独立验证和统一的计量规则。

fact.subject: 智元机器人 AGIBOT
fact.object: Worken有效智能工时及同期机器人平台更新

evidence.quote: AGIBOT today introduced Worken, a proposed framework for measuring the productivity of robots in real-world environments, at AGIBOT Innovation Day 2026 in Shanghai. Combining the words “Work” and “Token,” the concept seeks to shift attention beyond the number of robots manufactured or deployed toward how much useful work they can perform autonomously and consistently.

The company also unveiled AHA3, its integrated “three intelligences in one” hardware platform, and highlighted advances in its AGILE motion intelligence framework, including a new self-evolving agent capability. AGIBOT debuted GO-3 Preview, its next-generation embodied AI foundation model, showcased its WITA-Omni 1.0 omni-modal interaction model, and launched the G2 Max industrial robot and Link-U OS 1.0.
